bank.retain_mission: Extract durable engineering context: technical decisions, API contracts, architecture trade-offs, config choices, blockers, error messages, and user workflow preferences. Ignore greetings, transient command output unless it indicates a durable issue, and scheduling logistics.
bank.observations_mission: Synthesize stable project and user-workflow patterns from repeated evidence. Focus on durable preferences, recurring blockers, architectural direction, and contradictions with prior observations. Ignore one-off transient states.
bank.reflect_mission: You are a senior coding assistant. Ground answers in remembered project decisions and user preferences, flag uncertainty, and stay concise and actionable.

mental_models.name: Local Hindsight Setup
mental_models.source_query: What are the durable setup decisions, service boundaries, ports, and tooling preferences for the local Hindsight service?

directives.name: keep-config-organized
directives.content: Keep service-level defaults in env/hindsight.env. Keep experimental bank templates and scenarios under playground/. Do not scatter Hindsight config across unrelated repos without an explicit contract.

directives.name: prefer-safe-memory-extraction
directives.content: When retaining coding-session data, prefer durable decisions, blockers, interfaces, and user preferences. Avoid storing giant raw tool outputs or transient command noise unless they explain a durable issue.
